heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for premium visual, video, and multimodal content creation.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a full-bleed dark hero as a creative command center: the left side carries the headline and CTA stack, while the right side is a layered dashboard collage of generated image cards, video preview tiles, and capability chips. blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 & Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance | AI Image and Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Generate high-quality AI images and videos with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance. Explore multimodal capabilities, trusted by leading brands, and get started with AI-generated visuals in minutes.

sections.backgroundTreatment: dark full-bleed hero with layered dashboard overlay, floating model chips, and a right-side collage of generated image and video preview tiles
sections.designNote: Content-first hero that answers what this is, who it is for, and what to do next. Keep the ad-message continuity with a premium, high-contrast dark hero. Include a compact benefit list under the subheadline, and place the single CTA 'Get started' as a solid orange pill. Make the right side visually expressive with poster-style outputs, video frame strips, and waveform/audio sync cues.

Immediate logo-led trust section placed early, directly after the hero, using 3-6 recognizable brand logos in a clean horizontal strip. If fewer than 3 logos are available, fall back to a metric strip. Keep it lighter in tone to create strong contrast after the dark hero.

Do not use a generic SaaS feature grid. Use a tabbed feature story with a live preview panel, alternating focus between Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Seedream should lead with image quality, text rendering, multimodal editing, and composition. Seedance should emphasize synchronized audio-video generation, lip-sync, and cinematic motion. Each product block should feel distinct in pacing and visual treatment, with one side feature-led and the other preview-led.

Use a centered comparison-style pricing area with two clear purchase paths rather than a broad plan grid. Highlight Seedance 1.5 Pro as the higher-investment workflow option and keep Seedream 4.5 equally premium but visually distinct. CTA buttons must all read 'Get started' and use the accent color at full opacity.

Because there are 4+ testimonials, use a carousel to control density and change rhythm after the pricing section. Keep this section credibility-focused, with quote cards that are clean, editorial, and easy to scan. Emphasize creative, video, and marketing use cases.

Final conversion section should be the strongest CTA moment of the page. Use a floating centered card with concise supporting copy and a single full-width mobile CTA labeled 'Get started'. Keep the background dark again to close with high contrast and a premium enterprise feel.

blueprint.designPersonality: A premium AI creative command center: dark, structured, fast, and enterprise-ready, with orange brand energy and logo-led trust.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use layered UI mockups, product-output galleries, and short video preview tiles. The hero should show a collage of generated posters, image edits, cinematic video frames, waveform/audio sync cues, and floating capability chips. Trust should be dominated by a horizontal logo band and proof metrics above the fold.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long, so a smaller hero size keeps the layout premium and prevents wrapping from feeling crowded.

colours.colourReason: The brand palette already provides a strong orange identity, so the page should use a dark hero and dark sections with orange as the main action color. This keeps the landing page unmistakably tied to Techjockey’s brand while making the AI product feel bold and high-contrast.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split hero with brand logo placement, large left-aligned headline, short supporting paragraph, and a compact benefit list using white-on-dark icon bullets. Hero is visually dense but structured, with strong hierarchy and minimal CTA emphasis in the hero area.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top hero band followed by a lead form block, then stacked content sections with clear vertical separation. Rhythm favors long-form scanning with alternating dense text and modular feature blocks.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Lead capture card with strong border radius, white surface, internal padding, and form-field grouping. Feature content is presented in simple information blocks rather than decorative cards; utility-first rather than glassy or elevated.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is concentrated in the lead form area rather than repeated across the hero. CTA treatment should be high-contrast, single-action, and conversion-focused, with secondary actions deemphasized or absent.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No visible pricing module pattern in the reference. If introduced, it should follow the same utility-led approach: simple plan cards, concise inclusions, and strong CTA placement rather than complex comparison tables.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the reference. Likely minimal utility footer or omitted in favor of conversion-first page flow.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo-led hero with no dominant product imagery. Visual support, if used, should be limited to small brand marks, icons, or simple illustrative elements rather than immersive media panels.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Long-form stacked product sections with a label, headline, explanatory paragraph, then feature list. Best suited to modular sections that can be repeated for multiple offerings, each with a consistent title-description-features structure.
referenceMap.formPattern: Prominent lead form card placed immediately after the hero, with many hidden tracking fields and a compact visible field area. Form design is conversion-oriented, controlled, and likely validated with inline behavior.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-first presentation with no obvious motion system in the reference. If motion is added, it should remain subtle and functional, not decorative.
designNotes: Use strong typographic hierarchy with one dominant headline and concise supporting copy.
Keep hero content compact and utilitarian.
Place lead capture immediately after first-screen value communication.
Favor simple lists and stacked modules over complex interactive UI.
Use dark hero surfaces and lighter content surfaces for contrast, but avoid heavy visual embellishment.
Design for professional B2B trust and speed of comprehension.

avoidPatterns: Generic AI stock imagery without product proof
Overly minimal hero that weakens the value proposition

Bright/light theme styling that reduces the premium futuristic feel
Decorative animations that distract from the visual outputs
Long unbroken text blocks without modular scanning structure
designStrategy.reasoning: This page should convert professionals who already understand AI generation and are evaluating a high-value solution, so the strategy should be warm, product-led, and demo-oriented rather than awareness-led. Because the visitor trusts logos most, the dominant trust treatment should be logos-first, with immediate brand credibility placed near the top of the page. The dark theme supports a premium, futuristic, high-end AI positioning and helps generated visuals and video thumbnails pop. A split hero is the best fit because it can carry a strong product message alongside proof-oriented media without feeling crowded. The page should stay dense enough to communicate two related models clearly, but the content must be modular for scanability. Since the reference pattern favors lead capture lower in the funnel, the hero should introduce the value and the first major proof section should drive demo or quote action. The video gallery is essential because Seedance is motion-based, and the overall page should show outputs rather than only describing capabilities.
